text:
Marta: Kicked off a 2% canary for model v8-int4 on /generate targeting the cross-doc-merge workload (documents concatenated, >3k tokens). Early signals show a factuality-index drop vs v7-fp16 baseline. Posting quick diffs.
Devon: share the slice numbers pls.
Marta: snapshot:
```
slice: cross-doc-merge (>=3000 tokens)
  baseline(v7-fp16): factuality_index=0.912, halluc_rate=3.2%, mrr=0.838, p99=240ms
  v8-int4:         factuality_index=0.871 (-0.041), halluc_rate=6.1% (+2.9pp), mrr=0.827 (-0.011), p99=253ms (+13ms)
slice: single-doc (<800)
  baseline: factuality_index=0.945, halluc_rate=1.0%
  v8-int4: factuality_index=0.943 (-0.002), halluc_rate=1.2% (+0.2pp)
notes: token-cpu -19%
```
Hannah: That's a clear hit on the merged-doc slice; our rollout gates define auto-fallback if any core slice has hallucation uptick >=2.0pp OR factuality_index delta <= -0.03. This would trip both rules.
Jules: Do we have per-layer cache eviction metrics? Merged docs often cause interleaved KV contexts; quant kernels can change eviction timing.
Marta: KV hit-rate delta for cross-doc: baseline 89.0% -> v8-int4 82.1% (-6.9pp). Also saw an increase in attention-projection eviction spikes on layers 18-22.
Devon: That lines up. Cache churn -> more re-generation -> hallucination. OpsBot, what nodes got the canary?
OpsBot: Canary 5076543210 deployed: 2% traffic to pool "dedicated-n" (A100s). Observability job "onboard-crossdoc-seed" scheduled. No runtime OOMs recorded.
Hannah: Proposal: immediately reduce to 0.5% and add an emergency routing rule to route any request matching cross-doc-merge to v7-fp16. Keep shadowing enabled for v8-int4 to collect traces. Also run a seeded 200k cross-doc eval overnight with severity buckets.
Jules: We should also add a composite automatic fallback metric: FallbackScore = max( (halluc_delta/2.0), (-factuality_delta/0.03), (kv_hit_delta/3.0) ). If FallbackScore >= 1.0 -> immediate reroute. That normalizes different signals.
Marta: I like that. For this run numbers: halluc_delta=+2.9pp -> 2.9/2.0=1.45, factuality_delta=-0.041 -> 0.041/0.03=1.37, kv_hit_delta=-6.9pp -> 6.9/3.0=2.3 => FallbackScore=2.3 (trips).
Devon: Action plan: 1) throttle 2%->0.5% now; 2) pin cross-doc-merge to v7-fp16; 3) run seeded 200k cross-doc eval + layer eviction traces; 4) build v8-fp16 to isolate quant; 5) run per-layer mixed-quant where attn-proj layers stay int8/fp16.
OpsBot: Traffic change executed at 5076543220: 2% -> 0.5%. Routing rule applied: cross-doc-merge pinned to v7-fp16. Shadowing of v8-int4 continues.
Hannah: I'll push the FallbackScore computation into the canary dashboard and set it as the canonical auto-fallback gate. Add MRR smoothing window = 10m to reduce noisy flips.
Jules: Also add an experiment to instrument KV key lifetimes and see if certain prompt separators or doc boundaries accelerate eviction. Could be a prefix-shift artifact in tokenization+kvs.
Marta: Good call. Will upload the seed corpus and tag ops for kernel-level tracing. Will report back with the seeded eval link. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
